sealed_evidence_derived_guard_audit.interpretation: On the sealed initial formulas R33 and R34 are already inactive. The observed no-op versus changed split is therefore controlled at the next frozen stage by R35B single-literal RUP vivification.

G0_EXACT_SIMPLE_3CNF_NONEMPTY.formal_statement: F is canonical and nonempty; every clause has exactly three literals on three distinct variable identities.
G0_EXACT_SIMPLE_3CNF_NONEMPTY.counterexample_route: Permit shorter clauses, repeated variable identities inside a clause, or noncanonical duplicates and the listed automatic exclusions can fail.
G0_EXACT_SIMPLE_3CNF_NONEMPTY.proof_obligation: Direct case analysis of the frozen R33 ordering and canonicalization.

G1_BALANCED_BIPOLAR_OCCURRENCE.formal_statement: For every used variable x, p_x>0 and q_x>0, where p_x and q_x count positive and negative occurrences.
G1_BALANCED_BIPOLAR_OCCURRENCE.counterexample_route: Any variable occurring in one polarity only triggers frozen pure-literal elimination.
G1_BALANCED_BIPOLAR_OCCURRENCE.proof_obligation: Show G3 implies an opposite-polarity occurrence for every literal occurrence, hence implies G1.

G2_SIMPLE_UNIFORM_3CNF_WITH_UNIQUE_VARIA.formal_statement: Every clause is a simple width-3 clause and no two clauses have the same unordered variable triple.
G2_SIMPLE_UNIFORM_3CNF_WITH_UNIQUE_VARIA.counterexample_route: R34 nonrecognition only needs at least one triple-group to fail the complete parity-bundle condition; global uniqueness is stronger than necessary.
G2_SIMPLE_UNIFORM_3CNF_WITH_UNIQUE_VARIA.proof_obligation: Split into G0 plus the weaker exact R34-negation G_AFF below.

G3_NO_BLOCKED_CLAUSE.formal_statement: For every C in F and every literal l in C, there exists D in F with -l in D such that Res_l(C,D) is non-tautological.
G3_NO_BLOCKED_CLAUSE.counterexample_route: A clause-literal pair for which every opposite-polarity resolvent is tautological is a direct frozen BCE witness.
G3_NO_BLOCKED_CLAUSE.proof_obligation: Negate first_blocked_clause exactly, including the vacuous-blocking case when no opposite literal exists.

G4_EXACT_NO_BVE_CANDIDATE.formal_statement: For every variable x with parent sets P_x,N_x, let R_x be the distinct non-tautological resolvents and T_x(F)=canon((F minus (P_x union N_x)) union R_x). Require NOT(|R_x| <= |P_x|+|N_x| AND measure(T_x(F)) < measure(F)) in lexicographic (C,L,V).
G4_EXACT_NO_BVE_CANDIDATE.counterexample_route: Find x with |R_x| <= |P_x|+|N_x| and strict transformed-measure decrease.
G4_EXACT_NO_BVE_CANDIDATE.proof_obligation: Mirror the exact two-part frozen bve_candidate predicate.

G4S_BVE_RESOLVENT_SURPLUS.B1_D15_special_case: p_x+q_x=15, so |R_x|>=16 is sufficient; sealed initial B formulas actually have minimum |R_x|=40 and minimum surplus=25.
G4S_BVE_RESOLVENT_SURPLUS.counterexample_route: A formula may still block BVE with |R_x|<=|P_x|+|N_x| if transformed measure does not strictly decrease, proving surplus is not necessary.
G4S_BVE_RESOLVENT_SURPLUS.proof_obligation: Immediate from frozen BVE acceptance conjunction.

G_AFF_NOT_COMPLETE_AFFINE_BUNDLE.formal_statement: The entire simple 3-CNF is not exactly a conjunction of complete parity bundles recognized by frozen R34; equivalently for simple 3-CNF there exists a variable-triple group whose signed pattern set is not exactly one four-pattern parity class.
G_AFF_NOT_COMPLETE_AFFINE_BUNDLE.counterexample_route: Partition all clauses by variable triple into exact four-clause parity halfcubes.

G_HORN_NOT_HORN.formal_statement: At least one clause contains at least two positive literals.
G_HORN_NOT_HORN.counterexample_route: A Horn formula satisfying the other reduction-avoidance conditions stops at the Horn terminal instead of portfolio fixpoint.
G_HORN_NOT_HORN.proof_obligation: Directly unfold frozen R33 terminal ordering.

G5_SINGLE_LITERAL_RUP_IRREDUCIBLE.formal_statement: For every C in F and each removed literal l in C, UP(F under assumptions {-a : a in C minus {l}}) does not derive contradiction.
G5_SINGLE_LITERAL_RUP_IRREDUCIBLE.counterexample_route: Any one clause/literal pair whose strengthened-clause negation causes UP conflict is the next frozen R35B proposal.
G5_SINGLE_LITERAL_RUP_IRREDUCIBLE.proof_obligation: Unfold first_rup_strengthening and run_candidate, including final unassumed UP check.

G6_NONTERMINAL_CLASS_EXCLUSION.formal_statement: Exclude the exact frozen terminal catalogue on the unchanged formula.
G6_NONTERMINAL_CLASS_EXCLUSION.counterexample_route: A reduction-stable formula may still be classified by the post-reducer recognizer as renamable-Horn, dual-Horn, or beta-acyclic.
G6_NONTERMINAL_CLASS_EXCLUSION.proof_obligation: Keep reducer terminal semantics separate from post-reducer catalogue recognition.

redundancy_and_order_findings.restart_dependence: If the conditions force zero transformations in the first cycle, no restart occurs and no closure-under-restart invariant is needed. If any earlier transformation is permitted, all downstream conditions must be re-established on the transformed formula and the simple one-cycle lemma no longer applies.
redundancy_and_order_findings.operator_order_dependence: The proof uses the exact frozen order R33 -> R34 -> R35B -> stop-if-RUP-unchanged.

MINIMAL_REDUCTION_STABILITY_CANDIDATE.name: HASH_FREE_ONE_CYCLE_FROZEN_REDUCER_FIXPOINT_LEMMA
MINIMAL_REDUCTION_STABILITY_CANDIDATE.CLAIM: For every canonical nonempty exact simple 3-CNF F, if (i) G3_NO_BLOCKED_CLAUSE holds, (ii) G4_EXACT_NO_BVE_CANDIDATE holds, (iii) F is not Horn, (iv) G_AFF_NOT_COMPLETE_AFFINE_BUNDLE holds, and (v) G5_SINGLE_LITERAL_RUP_IRREDUCIBLE holds, then the exact frozen reducer performs zero transformations, executes one cycle, returns residual F unchanged, and reports STALLED_PORTFOLIO_FIXPOINT.
MINIMAL_REDUCTION_STABILITY_CANDIDATE.DOMAIN: Canonical nonempty exact simple 3-CNF; no SHA assumption, no degree-15 assumption, no random/expander assumption.
MINIMAL_REDUCTION_STABILITY_CANDIDATE.WHAT_LANE_B_SUPPORTS: All 14 sealed initial B formulas had zero R33 transformations and R34 nonrecognition. The 11 exact no-op records also satisfied zero R35B strengthenings; the 3 changed records identify failure of G5 as the next active guard. Direct sealed-formula guard audit found BCE witnesses everywhere and BVE surplus everywhere.
MINIMAL_REDUCTION_STABILITY_CANDIDATE.WHAT_LANE_B_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT: No universal quantification, no infinite family, no treewidth lower bound, no separator/expansion theorem, no claim that SHA-generated formulas satisfy these conditions for all n.
MINIMAL_REDUCTION_STABILITY_CANDIDATE.KNOWN_PRIOR_ART_COLLISION: The component reductions and their fixpoint complements are standard SAT-preprocessing territory; exact conjunction tied to this frozen controller has not received a dedicated exhaustive novelty audit.
MINIMAL_REDUCTION_STABILITY_CANDIDATE.COUNTEREXAMPLE_ROUTE: Exhibit a canonical exact simple 3-CNF satisfying every listed condition for which frozen R33 changes/stops early, R34 recognizes affine, R35B strengthens, or the controller does not return unchanged STALLED_PORTFOLIO_FIXPOINT.
MINIMAL_REDUCTION_STABILITY_CANDIDATE.REQUIRED_CERTIFICATE: Independent symbolic guard-by-guard proof/certificate that G0+G3+G4_exact+NOT_HORN+G_AFF+G5 imply the exact frozen branch outcomes and one-cycle no-change controller stop.

OPEN_CORE_EXTENSION_CANDIDATE.CLAIM: Under the minimal reduction-stability candidate, if F is additionally outside RENAMABLE_HORN, DUAL_HORN, and BETA_ACYCLIC under the exact frozen recognizers, then post-reducer terminal recognition returns OPEN_CORE.

WEAKER_PROVABLE_CANDIDATE.name: LINEAR_15_REGULAR_7_8_SIGNED_3CNF_SUFFICIENT_SUBCLASS
WEAKER_PROVABLE_CANDIDATE.CLAIM: Let F be a canonical exact 3-CNF whose underlying 3-uniform variable hypergraph is linear (distinct clauses share at most one variable), 15-regular, and every variable has polarity counts {p_x,q_x}={7,8}. Then tautology/unit/pure/subsumption/BCE/BVE are inactive, F is not Horn, frozen R34 cannot recognize a complete affine bundle, and every single-literal R35B candidate is UP-nonconflicting. Therefore the frozen reducer performs zero transformations and returns F unchanged as STALLED_PORTFOLIO_FIXPOINT after one cycle.
WHY_EASIER: Linearity plus opposite polarity makes every BCE witness resolvent non-tautological.
For each x, linearity makes all p_x q_x=56 positive-negative resolvents non-tautological and distinct, so 56>15 blocks BVE by the frozen count guard.
Linearity makes every variable triple unique, so R34 sees group size one instead of the required four-clause parity bundle.

Under two assumptions from one 3-clause, linearity ensures every other clause contains at most one assigned variable; after the source clause forces the third literal, every other clause still has at most one assigned variable, so no UP contradiction occurs.
Total positive occurrences are at least 7n while a Horn formula with m=5n clauses has at most 5n positive occurrences, so F is not Horn.
WEAKER_PROVABLE_CANDIDATE.IMPORTANT_LIMIT: This subclass is not an explanation of the sealed Lane-B formulas themselves: analytic inspection of the sealed initial CNFs finds clause pairs sharing two variable identities in every one of the 14 records, so those formulas are not linear.

explicit_infinite_family_feasibility.reason: SHA is not logically needed by either candidate lemma. An explicit algebraic/cyclic 3-uniform regular signed construction could target the sufficient conditions. The narrow linear 15-regular 7/8 subclass gives a particularly transparent route, but existence for an infinite admissible sequence with all required signing and any desired post-terminal/treewidth properties must be established separately.

COUNTEREXAMPLE_PROGRAM: Independently certify or falsify G3=>G1 under the exact BCE definition.
Find a formula showing G4S surplus is not necessary while G4_exact still blocks BVE.

Search conceptually for a canonical exact simple 3-CNF satisfying G0,G3,G4_exact,NOT_HORN,G_AFF but violating G5; the three sealed small Lane-B records already instantiate this role at evidence level.
For the minimal lemma, a single formula satisfying every premise yet changed by the frozen reducer is a decisive formalization counterexample.
For the OPEN_CORE extension, seek a reduction-stable formula that is renamable-Horn or beta-acyclic to demonstrate why post-terminal exclusions cannot be dropped.
For the linear sufficient subclass, attempt a direct symbolic proof before constructing any infinite family.
